result.stdout:
Black Sails — deploy web applications and declarative agents

Usage: blacksails <command>

  login                    Sign in with a browser device code
  logout                   Remove the local session
  whoami                   Show the signed-in Black Sails account
  init [--project PATH]    Link or create an application
  deploy [options]         Build locally and deploy (supports CI service tokens)
  runnable-build ...       Build inside an authorized Runnable workflow
  deployments              List recent deployments
  logs [DEPLOYMENT_ID]     Show branded deployment logs
  rollback [DEPLOYMENT_ID] Restore a previous ready deployment
  env list                 List secret names
  env set KEY [--stdin]    Create or replace a secret securely
  env delete KEY           Delete a secret
  agent init DIRECTORY     Create a declarative agent bundle
  agent validate PATH      Validate an agent directory or ZIP
  agent deploy PATH --app APP  Validate and deploy an agent bundle
